# npm

<!-- Generated by tools/clientrecipes from src/npm.json; edit the source. -->

Read the [common setup and credential rules](README.md) first. [All recipes](index.md).

Client: **Bundled npm on Node 26.13.0; npm 12.2.1 on Node 26.13.0**. Registered classes: **local, remote, virtual, federated**.

Endpoint: `${AW_URL}/artifactory/api/npm/${AW_REPO}/`

## Before connecting

- A new project/package directory with package.json.
- Python 3 is required by the configuration snippet to encode runtime credentials safely.

Authentication: Use AW_USER and a short-lived AW_TOKEN whose subject is AW_USER. The server accepts an access/reference token as the Basic password and rechecks the subject and repository permissions. Reading requires read permission; publication requires write permission and replacement may require delete permission.

Fresh client state: Run in a disposable client container with a new /work mount, or a new temporary project directory with all the client home/cache paths below. The acceptance harness uses a new scenario directory and container. Never reuse your normal client home for this check.

## Configure

The auth entry is scoped to this exact repository path. .npmrc contains an encoded secret; keep it private and untracked.

```sh
export npm_config_cache="$(mktemp -d)"
umask 077
python3 - <<'PYCODE'
import base64, os
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
u = os.environ["AW_URL"] + "/artifactory/api/npm/" + os.environ["AW_REPO"] + "/"
p = urlsplit(u)
a = base64.b64encode((os.environ["AW_USER"] + ":" + os.environ["AW_TOKEN"]).encode()).decode()
with open(".npmrc", "w") as f:
    f.write("registry=" + u + "\n//" + p.netloc + p.path + ":_auth=" + a + "\n")
PYCODE
export npm_config_userconfig="$PWD/.npmrc"
export npm_config_globalconfig=/dev/null
```

## Publish

Classes: **local**. Publish only to the classes listed here. A federated recipe proves one-node behavior; remote repositories are read-only client sources.

producer/package.json supplies the package name/version. Scoped packages work with this registry too.

```sh
npm publish ./producer
```

## Install or resolve

Classes: **local, remote**. Use the selected repository key. Virtual resolution requires readable configured members; remote resolution requires an administrator-configured upstream.

Replace the package coordinates with a package available in this repository.

```sh
npm ping
npm view acme-pub dist-tags.latest
npm install acme-pub@1.0.0
```

## Limits

Classes outside **local, remote, virtual, federated** are not registered for this format. Commands above apply only to each operation's listed classes. Federated evidence is for one node; it does not establish cross-vendor replication.

- For verification, use a new project with no node_modules/lockfile and a new npm cache.
- A repeated publish of an existing version is refused; --force does not make publication idempotent.
- The catalog also registers virtual/federated classes, but this recipe only advertises classes with matching native-client evidence. Registered configuration support alone is not a native recipe qualification; remaining virtual/federated proof belongs to the follow-on phase.
